notes.title: True Tales of Bloodstreet 13: the ending you did NOT expect.
notes.content:
Sad news, today Alterego Games is making it official that there is no place for “The True Tales of Bloodstreet 13” in our near future.  Other projects are eating away our time, and we don’t want to create a false hope for those waiting out for a part 2 and more. This means that everyone craving for the epic conclusion of Daniel, Bill, Veronique and Hannah will have to imagine the ending on their own for now.

In other news, our studio will be releasing a spiritual successor, a detective horror adventure game! 

[h1][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275660/Sanity_of_Morris/][b]Sanity of Morris[/b][/url][/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33971652/4c11c0297ead6cd8c37c71b0edd165324b3b36f6.gif[/img]

Sanity of Morris is a psychological horror adventure game complete with scary basements and strange visions. Using your flashlight reveals the vital clues you need, but risks you being seen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33971652/c7347873146a689c5a4bbbd446df2e708639161a.gif[/img]

The game combines elements of stealth games with detective-adventure and psychological horror for a gripping story. Discover the truth! Could aliens be real?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275660

True Tales of Bloodstreet 13 will forever have a special place in our hearts as it is the start of our craving to create entertainment products. So perhaps, one day in the future we will revisit the “True Tales” concept with brand new game concepts. But if we do, we’d probably have to start at the beginning, restart the project and take it ‘from the top’!

notes.title: Next Game Announcement: Sanity of Morris!
notes.content:
[i]StickyLock Studios and Alterego Games proudly announce the Psychological Horror Adventure game Sanity of Morris, to be released Q4 2020 for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, PC and MacOS. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275660/Sanity_of_Morris/]Demo [/url]available on the Steam Games Festival. 
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33971652/832a7fe6bcba5bc10b008b0b22851d421ea72607.jpg[/img]

[b]Sanity of Morris[/b]
In remote Greenlake you come to visit your father, but nothing is as you expected it to be. Forces are at work that don’t want you there, and they are armed. 

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Equipped with nothing more than a flashlight and a notebook, it is up to you to step into the shoes of Johnathan Morris and discern truth from fiction. Light reveals the clues you need to find your father, but also alerts the ones who are trying to hunt you down. Darkness keeps you hidden, but linger for too long, and you might go insane.

[i]“We wanted to create something new and exciting, but also keep doing what we’re good at; storytelling. So for Sanity of Morris we took from Woven the adventure genre, having collectibles and working with a strong narrative. But then we added a whole layer of psychological horror in the music, in the visuals, and it’s really unnerving! In this game, you will start to question John’s reality. It makes for an engaging experience, like an interactive movie, perfect for escaping daily life. And we can all use that right about now.” [/i]– Dominic de Graaf, Creative Director.

[b]Features:[/b]
Use your flashlight to reveal and interact with clues.
Crouch and sneak your way past enemies undetected.
Collect audio tapes, secret files and hidden pictures for your journal and create a timeline of events.
Balance seeking out new information against avoiding stress, or you might lose your sanity.
Discover the truth about your father and his alien conspiracies. Has he gone crazy…. Or have you?
 
Unique in Sanity of Morris is the way you will have to put yourself at risk, exposing yourself to the light and enemies that can see you, as you desperately search for clues and hidden messages left behind by your father. It’s a psychological horror with a detective adventure game twist.

Sanity of Morris is available to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275660/Sanity_of_Morris/]wishlist now on Steam. [/url]

notes.title: Woven OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Woven[/h1]

Did you like The True Tales of Bloodstreet 13, or perhaps you thought it was way to hardcore?
Alterego Games now presents their latest game [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/504690/Woven/]Woven[/url].[/b]

Welcome to a world where woollen creatures once lived in peace. Stuffy is a well-meaning but rather clumsy stuffed animal that wanders the world alone.
Glitch is a metal firefly that has lost its memory and identity.

Was Stuffy left behind? Where did all these machines suddenly come from? And what does Glitch have to do with any of this?
Join them on their journey through a world of wool, fabric and hidden dangers.
